| CHK001 | **`buildTenantClient.find` does not spread unknown args** — it lists `collection`, `depth`, `limit`, `sort`, `page`, `where` explicitly. Does T006 thread `select` through THERE as well as onto the type? A type-only change typechecks green and silently drops the select, so the personal columns are fetched and D2's bound does not exist | [feasibility] | FR-030, D2 | [ ] |
| CHK002 | With the bar absent for a signed-out visitor (CLR-002), what occupies its place in the card? A card whose height changes with the session reflows the band between two visitors — is the invitation the same size as the bar, or is the layout allowed to differ? | [completeness] | CLR-001, CLR-002, FR-009 | [ ] |
| CHK003 | Is the three-card cap applied in the QUERY (`limit: 3`) or after it? If in the query, the sort must be the one FR-003 declares or the three chosen are not the three intended | [clarity] | FR-003, FR-004 | [ ] |
| CHK004 | `ordemDestaque` is optional, so some rows are NULL. Postgres sorts NULLs **last** on ASC by default — is "a mission with no order sorts last" the intended product behaviour, or does it need `nulls first`? The requirement says "menor primeiro" and is silent on absent | [completeness] | FR-003 | [ ] |
| CHK005 | FR-022 makes `null` failed and `[]` empty. `nivelDoLab` returns an **object**, never an array — what is its empty? A lab at level 0 with 0 XP is a legitimate value, not emptiness. Does the spec say the three-way contract collapses to two for that block? | [consistency] | FR-012, FR-015, FR-022 | [ ] |
| CHK006 | FR-026 says four reads concurrently, but the personal overlay is awaited **after** them because it needs the mission ids. Is that a fifth read the requirement forgot? | CHK007 | Measured: `CardProjeto` renders **one** `href` for the whole card and no separate authorship anchor, so FR-035 is already true for it. | CHK008 | FR-004 shows "at most three". Is a band with **one** marked mission a grid of one card, or one card stretched across three columns? The mockup draws three and the layout is a grid | [completeness] | FR-004, US3 | [ ] |
| CHK009 | FR-007 says the arithmetic is expressed once. After D3's split the constant lives in `lib/content/missoes.ts` — what stops the Home computing a percentage from `ETAPAS_POR_ESTADO` in a second way, e.g. dividing before passing to `ProgressBar` instead of passing value/max? | [testability] | FR-007, D3 | [ ] |
| CHK010 | FR-011 says `VER TODAS ›` links to `/missoes`. Is the link present when the band is **empty**? US6's edge says yes; does any requirement make that testable, or could an implementer render the link only alongside cards? | [completeness] | FR-011, US6 | [ ] |
| CHK011 | FR-017 says top five "in the order `/ranking` declares". If `/ranking` changes its tie-break later, does the Home follow automatically, or is five a separate constant that could drift? | [consistency] | FR-017, FR-021 | [ ] |
